comparison.objective: Candidate rejects defective open cartons from a conveyor; PR-1882 joins articulated chain ends with a connector and retaining plate in a service cradle.
comparison.physical_skill: Moving-object interception, flap avoidance, and spill-free carrying versus bimanual hole/pin alignment, insertion, side-entry keeper engagement, and articulated-chain management.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires correct carton routing and stable released rejection without content loss; PR-1882 requires both holes seated, keeper fully retained, chain guided, joint cradled, hands clear, and 1 s stability, with workspace violations or disassembly revoking progress.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment and release are generic primitives; assembly and retention of an articulated joint test a different ability.
